name: Calendar Read Guard
description: Rewrites raw `gog calendar` reads (and broken fetch_calendar.py|jq pipes) in the exec tool to a clean multi-calendar fetch_calendar.py call, so a fast/low-context model that guesses gog flags or the wrong JSON schema still gets complete 3-calendar results.

defaultDays.description: Window (days from today) when the rewritten read names no date range.

minDays.description: Minimum span enforced when the read gives an explicit range but no --query.

minSearchDays.description: Window applied to a --query read that names no date range.
